basics.name: Wilson Espina
basics.label: Senior Frontend Engineer
basics.summary: Senior frontend engineer with 8+ years of experience delivering complex, distributed web applications for high-traffic, customer-facing products. Expert in React, JavaScript, and TypeScript, with a strong product mindset focused on customer value, performance, maintainability, and well-tested code (unit, integration, and E2E). Proven track record collaborating across product, design, QA, and engineering teams to break complex problems into shippable milestones and deliver measurable business impact.

experienceAreas.name: Project Work
points: Owned end-to-end frontend feature delivery for New Zealand's National Ticketing Solution, integrating React components with a backend-for-frontend (BFF) layer in a distributed architecture. Maintained high accessibility standards and regularly presented progress and trade-offs to senior business and C-suite stakeholders.
Collaborated closely with UX designers, iterating on Figma designs and offering feedback to refine delivery within sprint cycles.
Built accessible React components integrated with headless Contentful CMS content, improving user experience while streamlining content operations for non-technical teams.
Implemented Auth0 authentication flows to support secure, seamless sign-up and account access journeys.

experienceAreas.name: Delivering to deadlines
points: Quickly adapted to new technologies while working with New Zealand’s largest company, Fonterra, delivering interactive frontend solutions using Salesforce Lightning Web Components within tight delivery timelines.
Utilised cutting-edge frontend tooling to enhance productivity, incorporating Vite to accelerate build workflows, styling components with CSS-in-JS, and enhancing pages with Lottie animations.

experienceAreas.name: Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
points: Developed and refined A/B testing strategies to optimize user experiences and conversion rates, contributing directly to revenue growth.
Implemented bespoke web experimentation solutions in Optimizely and partnered with product, QA, and stakeholders to make data-driven delivery decisions.

experienceAreas.name: Process Improvement
points: Drove team efficiency improvements by refining Agile ceremonies, automating manual workflows, and optimizing Jira processes to speed up delivery.

experienceAreas.name: Project Work
points: Managed competing priorities to deliver against limited time and budget allocations set by clients.
Advocated for the latest CSS best practices and tooling within projects, resulting in reduced bundled sizes and increased maintainability.
Led the frontend development for a Wagtail CMS-driven blog for the Kiwibank website, integrating Elastic Search UI React components and maintaining accessibility best practices.

experienceAreas.name: ITVX Streaming Platform
points: Pioneered frontend adoption of an internal GraphQL API across Next.js web and Connected TV (CTV) platforms, optimizing queries to reduce over-fetching and enable dynamic layout composition for better scalability.
Built and coordinated delivery of React components across web and CTV applications used by millions of customers, while mentoring junior engineers and aligning implementation with product goals.
Developed TypeScript components within an Atomic Design System, improving consistency, reuse, and maintainability across the codebase.

experienceAreas.name: Mentoring
points: Facilitated and delivered technical GraphQL workshops for frontend engineers unfamiliar with the technology.
Provided in-depth mentorship to junior engineers through pairing sessions, ensuring their technical growth and proficiency.

experienceAreas.name: General Skills
points: Championed a "shift left" testing approach using Cypress and React Testing Library (RTL), improving code quality and accelerating feedback loops during development.
Optimized DOM rendering of a CTV application, mitigating performance issues on low-powered devices and improving user experience.
Successfully implemented the integration of subtitles for Samsung CTV devices on the ITV Hub, ensuring seamless and accessible viewing experience for users.
Utilised vanilla JavaScript following an object-oriented design approach to develop new features for the ITV Hub CTV application, improving user engagement and enhancing the overall user experience.

work.name: General Assembly
work.position: Lead Instructor for JavaScript Development Part-Time Course

experienceAreas.name: Teaching
points: Modernised the JavaScript remote course by incorporating current industry best practices and the latest tools, resulting in an enhanced learning experience for students.
Created and delivered engaging lessons, guided exercises, and focused homework, teaching the fundamentals of the JavaScript language to students and facilitating their skill development.

experienceAreas.name: Mentoring
points: Provided personalised support and one-on-one tuition to students working on personal projects, guiding them through development challenges and facilitating their growth as developers.

experienceAreas.name: General Skills
points: Implemented unit and integration testing to improve the health and stability of the front-end, resulting in higher-quality code and better user experiences.
Collaborated with the UX/UI team to realise customer journeys through the company's AngularJS web application, ensuring a cohesive and intuitive user experience.

experienceAreas.name: Learning
points: Completed an intensive web development and agile project techniques bootcamp at General Assembly London in 2017, where I learned the fundamentals of frontend engineering through structured learning and pair programming exercises.

experienceAreas.name: Project Work
points: Demonstrated knowledge and expertise in frontend technologies by building personal projects during the bootcamp.
Created an interactive maze game using jQuery, which incorporated HTML Audio Elements triggered by user events.
Completed an individual project that utilised React, Node, and Express to connect to the Strava and Google Maps APIs, resulting in a Strava run patterns application.

experienceAreas.name: General Skills
points: Supported the Utilities Delivery team in implementing HS2 processes to effectively manage the utilities works programme.
